title: 第1967章 点到为止第1966章 对峙
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
区区一个界皇四重，也配在他面前站着说话？
今日若不让这小子血溅当场，他楚君邪的脸面往哪搁？更重要的是，他要让这位云汐小姐看看，什么样的男人才配站在她身边。
“既然你执意找死，本公子便成全你。”
楚君邪冷笑一声，右手一翻，一柄通体碧绿的折扇凭空出现在掌中。
那折扇通体流光溢彩，扇骨由深海玄玉雕琢而成，扇面上绣着九条栩栩如生的金龙，赫然是一件六品灵器。
“九龙扇！”
围观的人群中有人惊呼出声，
“九玄天门的神兵！据说是以九条界皇巅峰的龙魂封印其中，一扇之下，山河变色！”
楚君邪听到周围的惊呼，脸上笑意愈发张狂，
这正是他想要的效果，在美人面前展露实力，让这个不知天高地厚的护卫成为他风采的最佳注脚。
“本公子本想点到为止，给你留几分颜面。”楚君邪轻轻摇着折扇，姿态风流倜傥，仿佛已经胜券在握，“但你既然不识抬举，那便怪不得我了。”
话音未落，他的身形骤然动了。
九玄天门的至高身法凌虚九转！
传闻此步法修炼至大成，可一步九转，虚实莫测，同阶之中几乎无人能捕捉其轨迹。
楚君邪虽是靠灵药堆砌的境界，但这套身法却练得颇为纯熟，此刻施展开来，大堂中顿时出现九道残影，每一道都栩栩如生，令人分不清真假。
“好身法！”
有人忍不住赞叹。
九道残影从不同方向扑向江尘，每一道都手持折扇，扇尖闪烁着幽光，楚君邪的真身隐在残影之中，嘴角噙着不屑的冷笑。
在他眼中，江尘已经被吓得呆立当场，连闪避都忘了。
真是废物。

不过正好，越是废物，越能衬托他楚少门主的威风。
电光石火间，楚君邪的真身已欺至江尘身前三尺，手中九龙扇以一种极其刁钻的角度点向江尘胸前要穴。这一击若是点实，即便是界皇中期的修士也要被封住经脉，三个时辰内动弹不得。
既能让这小子出丑，又不至于真的伤人性命——至少在美人面前，他要保持几分风度。
折扇破空，发出尖锐的啸声。
下一秒，扇尖刺入了“江尘”的胸膛。
楚君邪嘴角的笑容瞬间绽放，他甚至已经准备好了一句颇为装逼的台词。
然而下一瞬，他脸上的笑容凝固了。
没有刺入血肉的闷响，没有意料中的惨叫，折扇竟然直接从“江尘”的身体中一穿而过，仿佛刺入了一片空气。
残影！
楚君邪心中猛然一沉，但前冲之势已经收不住，整个人失去重心，向前猛栽出去。
咚咚咚！
他踉跄着向前冲出七八步，手中的九龙扇在地面上刮出一道刺目的火星，才堪堪稳住身形，没有被当场摔个狗吃屎。但即便如此，那狼狈的姿态也已经落在了在场所有人的眼中。
“噗嗤...”
不知是谁忍不住笑出了声。
这一声笑虽然立刻被压了下去，却如同一记响亮的耳光，狠狠扇在楚君邪脸上，他的脸色瞬间涨红，从额头到脖颈都火烧火燎，
而真正的江尘，不知何时已经退到了三步之外，依旧是那副淡然从容的模样，
content_en:
A mere fourth-level Realm Emperor is worthy of standing in front of him and talking?
If this boy's blood was not spilled on the spot today, where would he put Chu Junxie's face? More importantly, he wanted to show Miss Yun tide what kind of man was worthy of standing beside her.
"Since you insist on seeking death, I will help you."
Chu Junxie sneered, flipped his right hand, and a green folding fan appeared out of thin air in his palm.
The folding fan was full of radiance, the fan bones were carved from deep sea jade, and nine lifelike golden dragons were embroidered on the fan. It was a sixth-grade spiritual weapon.
"Nine Dragon Fan!"
Someone in the crowd of onlookers exclaimed,
"The divine weapon of Jiuxuan Tianmen! It is said that it is sealed with the peak dragon soul of the Nine Realm Emperors. Under one leaf, the mountains and rivers change color!"
When Chu Junxie heard the exclamations around him, the smile on his face became even crazier.
This was exactly the effect he wanted, to show his strength in front of a beautiful woman, making this guard who knew nothing about heaven and earth become the best footnote to his style.
"I originally wanted to stop the order and save some face for you." Chu Junxie gently shook his folding fan, with a graceful posture, as if he had already won. "But since you don't know how to show appreciation, you can't blame me."
Before he finished speaking, his figure suddenly moved.
Jiuxuan Tianmen's supreme body technique Lingxu turns nine times!
It is said that after practicing this footwork to great perfection, you can make nine turns in one step. It is so unpredictable that almost no one at the same level can catch its trajectory.
Although Chu Junxie relied on elixirs to build a realm, he was quite proficient in this set of movements. Now that he was using it, nine afterimages suddenly appeared in the lobby, each one so lifelike that it was difficult to distinguish between true and false.
"Good form!"
Some people couldn't help but admire it.
Nine afterimages rushed towards Jiang Chen from different directions, each holding a folding fan, the tip of the fan flashing with faint light. Chu Junxie's true body was hidden in the afterimages, with a disdainful sneer at the corner of his mouth.
In his eyes, Jiang Chen was so frightened that he stood on the spot and even forgot to dodge.
What a waste.
But it just so happened that the more trash he was, the more he could set off the majesty of his master, Young Master Chu.
In the flash of light and stone, Chu Junxie's true body was already three feet in front of Jiang Chen. The Nine Dragon Fan in his hand was pointing at the vital point on Jiang Chen's chest at an extremely tricky angle. If this attack is accurate, even a monk in the middle stage of the Realm Emperor will have his meridians sealed and unable to move for three hours.
It can make this kid look embarrassed without really hurting anyone's life - at least he has to maintain some grace in front of the beauty.
The folding fan broke through the air and made a sharp whistle.
The next second, the tip of the fan pierced "Jiang Chen's" chest.
The smile on Chu Junxie's lips instantly bloomed, and he had even prepared a rather pretentious line.
However, the next moment, the smile on his face solidified.
There was no muffled sound piercing flesh and blood, no unexpected scream, the folding fan actually passed directly through "Jiang Chen's" body, as if it had pierced a piece of air.
Afterimage!
Chu Junxie's heart suddenly sank, but he could no longer hold back his forward momentum. He lost his center of gravity and fell forward.
Boom, boom, boom!
He staggered forward and rushed forward seven or eight steps. The Nine Dragon Fan in his hand scraped a dazzling spark on the ground before he could stabilize his body and avoid being thrown to pieces on the spot. But even so, that embarrassing posture has fallen into the eyes of everyone present.
"Pfft..."
I don't know who couldn't help laughing.
Although this laughter was suppressed immediately, it was like a loud slap in the face, hitting Chu Junxie hard in the face. His face turned red instantly, and his forehead and neck were on fire.
As for the real Jiang Chen, he had retreated three steps away at some point, still looking calm and calm.
